steps.content:
07:27 a.m. August 20, N.F. 112
Square Boulevard, West District, DisCity

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Reporting from <color=#fb9259>Keylan Square</color>, center of the West District, and once a landmark of the DisCity's industrial belt.

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Since N.F. 33, it has borne witness to the establishment, development, and prosperity of the West District, and to its subsequent bankruptcy, decline, and decadence. In half an hour, it is going to witness yet another all-important negotiation...

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: After a lapse of thirteen years, the city council is now ready to reopen talks in the West District. The Legion, the Syndicate's rising gang, is to participate in the negotiation as the representative of the West District. The venue for the occasion is the former Keylan Exhibition Hall at the center of the square.

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: It will be a closed-door negotiation. <color=#fb9259>Burns</color>, director of the city council and former Chief of the Public Security Bureau, will attend in person. The whole community is waiting with bated breath for the outcome of the negotiation.

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: What will the West District, or rather the Syndicate gangsters, demand? Will the West District Order Management Regulations be undermined? What impact will this have on our city?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Tsk tsk! Look at all those scared damsels from the Eastside. A gas mask could have gone well with that ensemble.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Way too many cops, big vehicles... and all the helicopters in the air, like a huge swarm of flies! Does any of this look like they're here for a peaceful negotiation?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: If I were the Legion, I'd be in no mood for negotiation when I saw the nasty faces of these sons of guns. I'd be like... negotiation my ass, see you on the battlefield!
Watchtowers have been set up all around the square. The officials in charge are not out here to welcome the arrivals as a gesture of good faith. Only fully-armed sheriffs on guard everywhere.
A negotiation, in essence, is a game of comparative power. When the Legion delegation arrives, the atmosphere will only get more tense; a conflict is still a possibility.

The authorities and Syndicate, regular Joes and Sinners... there is such a huge gap between the former and the latter, and you're not expecting the gap to close up overnight, but the atmosphere is indeed highly unsettling.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Hey, are you the ushers sent out by the authorities?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yo boss!
She's here. Your shackles have reacted to her approaching, and you have come to the periphery where she is to enter the square, waiting for her arrival.
A cohort of alert armed sheriffs follows her closely. To your surprise, Zoya is here alone as the representative of the Legion.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I came here alone. Don't want to spook the fainthearted here.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Or you think they can beat me?
The sheriffs raise their guns nervously. Zoya pays them no attention. She looks at you, with a light-hearted smile on her face.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Relax. I know what these guys are made of... I'm used to it.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I'm curious... if there was a fight, which side would you take?

steps.speaker: Hecate & Hella
steps.content:
Don't stir things up. 
Your side for sure!

options: If I had to take a side, it would be my own side

steps.content: Give me a break, would you? We're here to figure out Syndicate's future together, and now both parties to the negotiation have some secret design. You're not making this easy for me.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Hahaha! If it were so easy to secure the future, the statue of our great man wouldn't have worried itself bald.

She is referring to the <color=#fb9259>Statue of Keylan</color> in the center of the square, a few hundred meters away. It is a memorial to the great scientist who brought the Hypercube to humanity, and a tribute to the grand city that he built.
Dr. Keylan himself was probably not bald. But half of his statue's face has been blasted off, making the face indiscernible, and the statue has long been an object of ridicule.
The statue's body is covered with layer upon layer of graffiti, like ugly transdermal patches. It's a reflection on Syndicate, damaged beyond the point of self-salvation.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: This is where the gangs fight for supremacy. The rule is the final winner gets to paint their gang logo on the topmost point of the statue, as a symbol of supremacy. This is how Syndicate operates.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Power seized through brute force will only be taken away by greater brute force. From fists to bullets, then to Mania weapons... ${PlayerName}, what do you think will run this place next?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: It'll be me. Haha.
She pats you on the back, smiling.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: There will be no more gang fights. The old order ends today, and I'm the one putting an end to it.
Is this one of the pep talks from the Legion commander? You can't help but laugh a little.
You're about to take her to the conference when several towering sheriffs appear out of nowhere and stand in front of you.
...You, singular.

steps.speaker: Sheriff A
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName}, a task has come up for you.

steps.speaker: Sheriff A
steps.content: We've learned through our investigation that a large number of people carrying Mania weapons are approaching the square. We do not yet know their intent, but we're sure they're not coming in good faith.

steps.speaker: Sheriff A
steps.content: The FAC has been entrusted by <color=#fb9259>the City Council</color> with security of the square and preventing any Mania event. Please track down these potential attackers, Chief.

steps.speaker: Sheriff A
steps.content: You've proved your competence and good judgement in your last task. No one else is capable of this task but you.

options: This isn't an excuse to get me out of the way?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What f***ing **! The negotiation is happening because of ${PlayerName}, and now you guys are kicking us out right before it starts? Do we look like idiots to you? Come, I'll shove this task up your **********.
You put your hand on Hella's lifting arm, cutting her off.
The sheriffs have raised their guns. They're in no intent to talk it out... They even seem happy to have been given a chance for confrontation.
Zoya is watching from the sidelines, a half smile playing around her lips. She does not look surprised at how the situation is going.

options: Commander, you okay with this arrangement?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Of course I'm not surprised. I know what they're like. I knew this could happen, and I'm okay with it.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I'm totally okay with it. Or rather, let's just say I'm happy to see that you are not on their side.
It seems like you are the only one who has not entered the "negotiation" mode.
You sigh and turn to the sheriff, answering with the same cold stiff voice.
But tell whoever assigned this to me... that I'll find out the background of those rats, and expose all the masterminds behind them.
This is a negotiation that I brokered. Whoever tries to sabotage it, I will make them pay.

steps.speaker: Sheriff A
steps.content: We look forward to hearing good news from you then. But please don't overstretch yourself. Your MBCC is not the highest level of ministry, after all.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Well... Cut the crap now! The negotiation is about to start, right? Get a move on then.
She leaves you and strides toward the sheriffs.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Loosen up, ${PlayerName}. Instead of wasting your time here, why don't you go around the area and seek out your old friends in Syndicate for a drink?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Your adventure in Syndicate is coming to an end. They must have a lot to say to you.

options: What about you? Do you have something to say to me?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Whatever I want to say has already been said. Just don't forget the conversation we had the other night.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Today, I'm gonna put an end to this mess.

<size=44>08:05: Zoya enters the conference hall.
08:13: The first police line outside the square is attacked by Syndicate gangsters.
10:42: The conference hall is destroyed. The FAC intervenes and imposes an emergency lockdown in Keylan Square.</size>
